usb_si_pi_review.evidence: Open: no independent review. Author measurements on the committed board (pcbnew, kicad/usb_uart.kicad_pcb) are recorded below so a reviewer can check them; they are not a sign-off.

measured.speed_class: Full speed, 12 Mbit/s. The CH342 datasheet (V1E, section 5.3) describes full-speed USB; the V1E sheet is the newest found, so a newer sheet may differ.
measured.layer_transitions_on_pair: 0. USB_DP and USB_DN are routed only on F.Cu with no via. The 23 W-SYNTH-DRC-016 warnings in reports/release.json are on other nets (the V3 rail, MODEM_IDLE, CTS0_LOW, TXD1, RXD1, RXD1_MCU, DTR1, RTS1, CTS1), so they say nothing about the pair's return path.
measured.skew_note: At about 6.7 ps/mm on FR-4 that is about 0.17 ns against an 83 ns full-speed bit, roughly 0.2 percent. It would matter at high speed (2.08 ns bit), which this part does not use. The imbalance is a routing artefact of the FreeRouting result, not a design choice.
measured.coupling: The pair is not routed as a coupled differential pair. The closest edge-to-edge gap between the two nets is 0.13 mm, and 24 segment pairs lie within 0.5 mm of each other. There is no controlled-impedance geometry: on two layers at 1.6 mm a 90 ohm pair needs about 1.18 mm traces, which does not fit.
measured.return_path: 91.4 percent of the pair's length sits over solid B.Cu GND fill (492 of 538 samples at 0.1 mm), so the return current has a plane under most of the route. Where the other 8.6 percent runs was not located.
measured.electrical_length: The longer trace is 38.6 mm, well under the 100 mm or so (4 ns minimum full-speed rise time) at which a trace stops being electrically short, so reflections are not a concern at full speed.
measured.what_is_left: An independent reviewer should accept or reject these figures and the conclusion that a full-speed pair of this length needs no impedance control, or ask for a redesign with matched lengths. Matching the lengths needs a different route or placement, which FreeRouting does not do for pairs.

jlcpcb_dfm.selected: 2 layers, FR-4 TG135, 1.6 mm, 1 oz outer copper, HASL with lead, green mask, white silkscreen, 5 boards. Assembly: Economic, top side, 5 boards.
findings: JLCPCB read the gerber zip as a 2-layer board of 32.23 x 40.99 mm, the same as the committed board.

The CPL covers SMD parts only. J2, J3, J4, J_VIO (pin headers) and H1 to H4 (mounting holes) are not in it, so JLCPCB reported them as missing and Economic assembly does not place them. The headers need hand soldering.

On the first upload JLCPCB matched 21 of 28 lines. The BOM has no LCSC numbers, so it matched by value and footprint, and the other 7 were chosen by hand: D1 PRTR5V0U2X,215 (C12333), D2 D5 D6 PTVS6V0S1UR,115 (C294622), U2 LP5907MFX-3.3/NOPB (C80670), R_TERM 0603WAF1200T5E (C22787), R_TNOW 0603WAF4701T5E (C23162). After that all 28 lines show as matched and confirmed.

The automatic match for D4 and D7 was TZ-P2-0603YGTCS1-0.6T (C916074), a yellow-green LED, but these are the red TX LEDs. They were changed by hand to KT-0603R (C2286, red 615 to 630 nm). The D3 match VLMTG1401-GS08 (C511604) was not checked for colour.

Warnings still shown: the resistor comments (for example 5.1k) differ from the matched part number (0603WAF5101T5E), and the matched LED line is used for more than one designator. Resistor values were compared by hand and agree.

LED polarity: in KiCad, D4 pad 1 (the left pad, the cathode of the LED footprint) is on net TXD0, as the design intends. JLCPCB's placement preview shows the cathode tick on the left end of D4 and D7, which is consistent, but this was read from a zoomed screenshot, D7 was not opened in KiCad, and JLCPCB has not confirmed the polarity of KT-0603R. Rotation of the other polarised parts (D1, D2, D5, D6, U1, U2, U3) was not checked.
None of these matches is a component review. They were picked from JLCPCB's search for DFM purposes.

findings.item: J1 courtyard to top board edge
findings.disposition: Open for independent mechanical approval. Checked against the HRO TYPE-C-31-M-12 drawing (C165948): the footprint puts the shell front face 0.50 mm inside Edge.Cuts (y -0.06 against the edge at y -0.56), and the 0.01 mm is only the F.CrtYd margin of 0.5 mm reaching the edge, so nothing of the connector body crosses it. The drawing gives the front edge as the layout datum and states no overhang or recess limit. A 0.50 mm recess of the plug face needs an enclosure cutout check, which has not been done.
